_comment: Recordings gallery for the /artwork/ page. Items with draft:true are admin-only visible. Items with src pointing at /captures/recordings/... play from S3 via CloudFront; once youtube_id is populated, the page uses a YouTube embed instead. Proposed items (proposed:true) don't have files yet — they're AppC pitch suggestions waiting for the autoplay-capture pipeline. On owner approval via the marketing-queue UI (POST /api/marketing/approve-to-artwork), the clip MP4 + thumbnail are copied from /captures/latest/ to the durable /captures/recordings/ prefix and a new entry is appended here with draft:true. Commit the file to publish.

recordings.title: The Chronicles of Nesis — Title Screen
recordings.description: The opening title screen: the quiet starting village of Larian Valley under drifting cloud shaders, scored by the main theme.

recordings.title: Cloud shadows over Laria

recordings.description: Full combat encounter from entry to victory. Showcases combat system, action overlay, and damage queue.
